newsitem.title: USA: March FCOJ falls 5.00-cent daily limit on weather.
newsitem.headline: March FCOJ falls 5.00-cent daily limit on weather.

text.p: FCOJ March futures fell the 5.00-cent daily limit in early trade Monday, as warm weather disappointed players and ongoing technical weakness contributed to the bearish sentiment, market sources said.
It's the lack of cold weather (in Florida) and supplies are seen ample," Paine Webber analyst Bernard Savaiko, said. "The specs had been counting on a freeze."

Mike Palmerino, a meteorologist with Weather Services Corp, forecast warm weather across the Florida citrus belt, through the week. He said lows could fall into the upper 30s (degrees Fahrenheit), still too warm to damage fruit.
At 1058 EST, most-active January was 5.00 cent lower to 85.70, traded 89.80 to 85.70, a new contract low. January was off 4.80 to 82.60, and the back months were down 0.05 to 5.00.
Some chartists see prices eventually heading to 65.00 cents.
